defective_pattern: Aggregating multiple demographic variables into a single concatenated or monolithic demographic table when explicit 1-to-1 table separation is required.
why_defective: Violates explicit user requirement for distinct demographic tables. Concatenated demographic tables obscure variance and can cause formatting failures when the number of subgroups is high.
observed_symptoms: Generation of a single demographic table combining multiple demographic categories.
Fewer demographic tables than the distinct demographic variables calculated.
corrective_remedy: Generate 12 distinct APA 7 demographic tables, one for each demographic variable, natively keeping their structural isolation.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect fewer than requested demographic tables or monolithic table headings.
